authored_scope: Random mode samples non-square grids from 10..24 per side (a synthetic extension of the 13..16 fixtures; 6..30 is accepted when width or height is given). It places 2..4 cups by default, or 1..6 via num_cups. Cups are V shapes of depth 1..4 or U shapes with inner width 1..4 and wall height 1..4; sizes above 3 are a synthetic extension. Distractor cups have capacities that differ from the target. The cup and filler colours 2 and 9 are randomly swapped, and other non-7 colours are accepted explicitly. The filler is a single bar, fully scattered singles, or mixed bars. Not supported: tilted or inverted cups, asymmetric U walls, filler placed inside a cup, cups touching or nested, scenes with no match or several matches.
authored_constraints: Cup bounding boxes are separated by at least one background cell, so each cup is its own 8-connected component.
No cup cell lies inside another cup's interior.
Filler pieces are straight bars that do not touch each other, even diagonally, and lie outside every cup's padded bounding box in random mode.
In explicit mode, filler cells may not lie in any cup interior.
No 8-connected filler component encloses background in any row, so the reversed role assignment never matches.
Exactly one cup's interior size equals the filler count. Random mode enforces this by excluding the target capacity from distractors, and explicit mode raises otherwise.
There is at least one filler cell, so the output always differs from the input.
Colours are in 0..9, differ from each other and from background 7.
